hook: That famous phrase about being the change you wish to see never came from Mahatma Gandhi.

sections.voiceover: That famous phrase about being the change you wish to see never came from Mahatma Gandhi.
b_roll: Archival photo of Mahatma Gandhi in India
Close up of historical quote text on parchment

sections.voiceover: India gained independence under his leadership before he died in 1948. Quote Investigator searched 13,826 works to find the truth. Where did the popular slogan actually originate?
b_roll: Historical map of India during the independence movement
Stack of historical books and archives in a library

sections.voiceover: Yet educator Arleen Lorrance wrote the earliest close match in 1974.
Literary Hub contributor Benoit Denizet-Lewis credits Arleen Lorrance with the quote. BBC Bitesize confirms zero historical records link Mahatma Gandhi to those words.
Arleen Lorrance published the phrase in 1974.
